remarks: Bright single level, corner location, ground floor in Northwood Condo. This two bedroom two bath home features two good sized bedrooms with their own walk-in closets, two remodeled bathrooms with beautiful soaking tubs, remodeled kitchen with ample cabinet space, huge front patio, inside stacked washer and dryer and a large living room. The community has two swimming pools with spas and a playground. This home is very close to New Horizon Elementary School, Le Space STEAM Education, Jefferey Trail Middle School, Orchard Park and Albertson's Supermarket! Also close to the many work areas of Irvine as well as UC Irvine.
